en.question: In Portugal, children go door to door on 1 November asking for Pão-por-Deus instead of trick-or-treating. Which would you rather keep?
followUps: What would you hand out at your door?

es.question: En Portugal, el 1 de noviembre los niños van de puerta en puerta pidiendo Pão-por-Deus en vez de "trick or treat". ¿Con cuál te quedás?

en.question: Who here is most likely to get lost on a night tour of Sintra and end up at the bottom of Quinta da Regaleira's well?
followUps: Who would go down to rescue them?

es.question: ¿Quién de acá se perdería en una visita nocturna a Sintra y terminaría en el fondo del pozo de la Quinta da Regaleira?

en.question: What's your scariest Portuguese bureaucracy story?
followUps: How long did it take to sort out?

es.question: ¿Cuál es tu historia más terrorífica con la burocracia portuguesa?

en.question: Montalegre holds a witches' night every Friday the 13th. Who here would actually go?

es.question: Montalegre hace una noche de brujas cada viernes 13. ¿Quién de acá iría de verdad?

en.question: What's the spookiest building you've seen in Portugal?
followUps: Would you spend a night there?

es.question: ¿Cuál es el edificio más tenebroso que viste en Portugal?

en.question: Would you rather walk through Alfama alone at 3am or spend the night in an empty palace in Sintra?
followUps: What story would you tell the next day?

es.question: ¿Qué preferís: caminar a solas por Alfama a las 3 de la mañana o pasar la noche en un palacio vacío de Sintra?

en.question: Who here is most likely to believe every word of a Portuguese neighbour's ghost story?
followUps: What would the story be about?

es.question: ¿Quién de acá se creería toda la historia de fantasmas de un vecino portugués?

en.question: What Portuguese thing scared you a little when you first moved here?

es.question: ¿Qué cosa de Portugal te dio un poco de miedo cuando recién llegaste?

en.question: In Portuguese folklore there's the lobisomem, a werewolf. If one lived in your neighbourhood, how would you spot it?
followUps: Who here would make friends with it?

es.question: En el folclore portugués existe el lobisomem, un hombre lobo. Si viviera en tu barrio, ¿cómo lo reconocerías?

en.question: Who here is most likely to celebrate Halloween, Pão-por-Deus and the Magusto chestnut festival all in the same fortnight?
followUps: Which one would they enjoy most?

es.question: ¿Quién de acá festejaría Halloween, el Pão-por-Deus y el Magusto de las castañas en las mismas dos semanas?
